patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are used for content sections, often pairing a large heading or image with a smaller block of descriptive text.
Large, expressive serif headings are paired with clean, legible sans-serif body text, creating a strong typographic contrast and hierarchy.
A predominantly light, off-white background is punctuated by bold, solid accent colors (pink, orange, dark grey) for specific content blocks and the footer.

The header transitions from transparent to a solid light grey background and becomes sticky as the user scrolls down the page. Content sections appear to reveal with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport.
Sections are separated by significant vertical whitespace, often featuring a large, centered serif heading that acts as a clear divider and focal point.

technique_notes: The site uses a sticky header that changes its background color from transparent to a solid light grey after a certain scroll threshold. Sections are revealed using scroll-triggered animations, likely leveraging GSAP ScrollTrigger to animate elements' opacity and vertical position as they enter the viewport, creating a staggered fade-up effect. The overall layout relies on generous padding and margin to create an airy feel, with full-width content blocks and image grids.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with a mix of regular and uppercase sans-serif body and label text.
design_tokens.radius: sharp corners for most elements, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons and input fields.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, with significant vertical and horizontal whitespace, especially in the hero and between major content sections, creating a sense of calm and focus.

standout: The site's distinctive quality lies in its confident blend of classic, elegant serif typography for headings with a modern, spacious layout and unexpected pops of bold, solid color. The 'Playground' section, featuring quirky 3D renders, adds a unique, playful touch that differentiates it from typical agency portfolios.
